answer: Every agent action gets written to a public log anyone can read. Fake identities are cheap, but they can't hide their tracks. Clone accounts tend to act in sync, and those patterns show up fast. A group of fakes buying the same saffron at the same second is a dead giveaway. One agent slips, and the ripple spreads through the whole cluster. Honest agents look messy and random. Clones move like they share a brain. Audit trails catch that velvet-smooth sameness, and the network flags the whole batch.
